trips.name: Santa Fe Springs Celebration
trips.route: Ichetucknee Springs Campground to Bowman's Landing
trips.included: Camping, catered breakfasts and dinners, daily lunch snacks and shuttle. Optional cabins at Bowman's Landing (Nov 6 and 7) cost extra.
trips.note: An extra day was added for the 100th trip.

trips.name: Florida Keys Challenge
trips.route: Six days of paddling from the Seacamp basecamp, with easy, mid and long routes each day
trips.note: Routes include Picnic Island, Coupon Bight, Little Torch Key, Bahia Honda State Park and Ramrod Key.

trips.name: Blackwater River + Coldwater Creek Experience
trips.route: Blackwater Joe's in Harold to Carpenter's Park in Milton
trips.included: Camping, catered breakfasts and dinners, daily lunch snacks, river maps and evening programs. Cabins at Blackwater Joe's are optional and extra.

trips.name: Suwannee River Paddling Festival
trips.route: Madison Blue Spring State Park down the Withlacoochee to the Suwannee, ending at Advent Christian Village
trips.included: Camping, catered breakfasts and dinners, daily lunch snacks, shuttles, river maps and evening entertainment with a benefit concert and speakers.

trips.name: 19th Annual Suwannee River Wilderness Trail
trips.route: Madison Blue Spring State Park to Ivey Memorial Park in Branford
trips.included: Camping, catered breakfasts and dinners, daily lunch snacks and evening programs. Two nights at river camps with screened platforms, fans and hot showers.

trips.name: St. Augustine History Paddle
trips.route: Base camp at Anastasia Island State Park with daily paddles to Salt Run, Princess Place, Castillo de San Marcos, the GTM Research Reserve and Fort Matanzas
trips.included: Camping, catered breakfasts and dinners, daily lunch snacks, river maps and evening programs.
